pr_title: Fix cluster bootstrap warning for single-node discovery
pr_body:
Suppresses periodic warning log about cluster bootstrapping configuration when
using single-node discovery.

Closes #96874
pr_comments: Thanks, @DaveCTurner for reviewing and approving this.

issue_context.title: Cluster bootstrap warning incorrectly emitted for `discovery.type: single-node`
issue_context.body:
In #86101 we added a warning if bootstrapping was incorrectly configured (and in #92744 we changed it to be emitted every 12h). The logic introduced doesn't take account of `discovery.type: single-node`, so explicitly-single-node clusters will always emit this warning even though they are correctly configured.

Relates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/58393.

review_comments: This does not verify that the bug is fixed, i.e. that the message is only emitted once. It would be sufficient to verify that `deterministicTaskQueue.runAllTasks()` completes. You'll need to do that in a separate test case, or at least earlier in this one, because there's no way to shut down the repeated logging from the badly-configured `ClusterBootstrapService` instance.
